dedupe_keys.name: gcn250 global gridded runoff curve numbers at 250 m

description: GCN250 is a global gridded dataset of USDA runoff curve numbers at 250 m, built from the ESA CCI 2015 land cover map resampled to 250 m and the HYSOGs250m hydrologic soil group map, and described in a Scientific Data descriptor. There are three rasters, one for each antecedent runoff condition: dry, average and wet. The authors note uses in hydrologic design, flood risk assessment and groundwater recharge modelling, and report that runoff ratios compare well with GLDAS. Coverage is global land. The rasters are a free download from figshare under CC BY 4.0 as GeoTIFF in WGS84. Caveats: the curve numbers are one static snapshot tied to 2015 land cover, and the figshare deposit dates from 2019. Simulation uses: runoff inputs for stormwater drainage design and flood modelling. Related records: EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) and HEC-RAS (model-hec-ras).
name: GCN250, global gridded runoff curve numbers at 250 m
provider: Authors of the Scientific Data descriptor (figshare deposit)
